name: Basketball Arena Blitz
summary:
Step onto the court and test your shooting touch in **Basketball Arena Blitz**—a focused VR basketball experience built for quick sessions, skill improvement and repeat play.

## 🏀 TWO WAYS TO PLAY

### 🎯 PRACTICE ROUTE

Work through 12 shooting positions with unlimited attempts. Begin near the basket, master the lane and elbows, then take on the three-point and half-court challenges.

Track your makes, attempts and accuracy while trying to complete the full route with fewer shots.
